git.purpose: Authored Rust source, fixture, authoritative reports, licenses/provenance, version/restore metadata; no raw geometry or rendered captures

excluded_build_cache: Cargo target outputs and local donor Git caches are retained locally but are not evidence inputs; consulted donor sources/history are archived separately.

raw.purpose: Exact consulted donor source/license snapshots and history; no code copied into engine
Actual capture sequence GIF; authored preview timing, not simulation learning
100 definitions,800 trial poses,full geometry witnesses and raw audit rows
Exact new source/inputs plus standalone reproduction workspace and original manifest/lock
Every build/test/replay attempt, null/failed setup, environment and preservation logs
First live UI, controls/save/restore evidence; clipped text/glyph failures retained
Intermediate UI and motion evidence; superseded by final v3
Final actual rendered generated geometry, ordinary-input walkthrough and capture provenance

git_restore_verification.purpose: Small authoritative post-archive restore/rebuild outcomes including exact command output

source_revision_v2.purpose: Source-only correction: common period for fractional-frequency authored preview channels; regression checks wrap continuity. No engine anatomy/output change.
